title: cfs
description: Industrial and calm: a warm putty-tan page with graphite text, deep navy bands and cards, and one burnt orange for every accent (dots, rules, ring buttons, underlines). A light neo-grotesk for big quiet headlines and a wide grotesk monospace for all labels, navigation and buttons. Square corners, hairlines, no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode (tan page); cfs blocks put navy bands in a `dark` subtree, so dark here is the navy of the footer and quote card
dark is a navy sibling: the page takes the cookie notice's deeper navy, cards the footer navy, orange unchanged
Mona Sans stands in for NB International (closed): within 1% of its width at 63px light; Azeret Mono for NB International Mono: same 0.643em advance
name: cfs-theme
